title: The 15 Best Restaurants in Alpharetta, GA (2026 Local Guide)
seoTitle: 15 Best Restaurants in Alpharetta, GA (2026): Avalon, Downtown & Beyond
h1: The 15 Best Restaurants in Alpharetta, GA
description: A local guide to the best restaurants in Alpharetta, Georgia for 2026: Avalon steakhouses, downtown Southern spots, sushi, brunch and more, with what to order at each.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic upscale restaurant patio scene at golden hour in a modern mixed-use shopping district, string lights, people dining outdoors, warm charcoal and gold tones, no text, no logos, no readable signs

faq.q: What is the best restaurant in Alpharetta?
faq.a: It depends on the night. For a steak dinner, locals point to Oak Steakhouse at Avalon or Cabernet Steakhouse on Windward. For Southern food, South City Kitchen and Smokejack lead the list. For something different, Rumi's Kitchen's Persian kabobs are a metro Atlanta favorite.

faq.q: Where should I eat at Avalon?
faq.a: Avalon's heavy hitters include Oak Steakhouse, South City Kitchen, Rumi's Kitchen, Colletta, Antico Pizza, Superica and The Cape's rooftop. Cafe Intermezzo is the move for dessert and late-night espresso.

faq.q: What restaurants are in Downtown Alpharetta?
faq.a: Downtown's Main Street area has Smokejack BBQ, The Southern Porch, Citizen Soul, Carson Kitchen, Hen Mother Cookhouse, Up On The Roof's rooftop brunch, Crust Pasta & Pizzeria and more, most within a short walk of the Town Green.

faq.q: Does Alpharetta have good brunch?
faq.a: Yes. Up On The Roof, Hen Mother Cookhouse and Carson Kitchen anchor downtown brunch, South City Kitchen and Superica run popular brunches at Avalon, and The Original Pancake House on Windward is the classic pancake stop.

title: 25 Best Things to Do in Alpharetta, GA (2026 Local Guide)
seoTitle: 25 Best Things to Do in Alpharetta, GA: Avalon, Greenway, Concerts & More
h1: The 25 Best Things to Do in Alpharetta, GA
description: The best things to do in Alpharetta, Georgia: Avalon, Downtown Alpharetta, the Big Creek Greenway, Ameris Bank Amphitheatre concerts, Topgolf, parks, family fun and free activities.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic wide view of a vibrant town green with a fountain, families and a farmers market on a sunny day, tree-lined walkable downtown in the background, warm tones, no text, no logos, no readable signs

faq.q: What is Alpharetta best known for?
faq.a: Alpharetta is known for Avalon and its revitalized downtown, the Ameris Bank Amphitheatre concert venue, the Big Creek Greenway trail system, and its standing as the Technology City of the South, home to hundreds of tech companies.

faq.q: What can you do for free in Alpharetta?
faq.a: Plenty: walk or bike the Big Creek Greenway and the Alpha Loop, visit the Town Green and Saturday farmers market, tour the free Alpharetta and Old Milton County History Museum inside City Hall, follow the downtown arts walk, and let the kids run at Wills Park or Webb Bridge Park.

faq.q: Is Alpharetta good for families?
faq.a: Very. Wills Park alone has three playgrounds, a pool and the equestrian center, and the city adds Topgolf, Main Event, The Cooler skate center, Adventure Air Sports, escape rooms and the splash fountain on the Town Green.

faq.q: When is the concert season at Ameris Bank Amphitheatre?
faq.a: The outdoor season generally runs April through October, with major country, rock and pop tours stopping at the 12,000-seat venue at Encore Park.

faq.q: What is the best coffee shop in Alpharetta?
faq.a: Valor Coffee on Milton Avenue is the local standard-bearer, a hometown roaster a block off Main Street. Warm Waves, Boarding Pass and Brewable round out a strong downtown coffee scene.

faq.q: Which Alpharetta coffee shops are good for working?
faq.a: Valor Coffee and Warm Waves downtown both have comfortable seating, and Fuel Coffee on North Main offers a roomy industrial-style space with a breakfast and lunch menu.

faq.q: What makes Brewable special?

seoTitle: Moving to Alpharetta, GA (2026): Neighborhoods, Jobs, Schools & Cost
h1: Moving to Alpharetta, GA: What to Know Before You Move
description: Thinking about moving to Alpharetta, Georgia? A practical guide to neighborhoods, the tech job market, commutes on GA 400, things to do and what living here is like.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic aerial view of an upscale suburban city at sunset with a walkable downtown, green tree canopy, modern office buildings and a highway in the distance, warm golden light, no text, no logos

faq.q: Why is Alpharetta called the Technology City of the South?
faq.a: Alpharetta is home to hundreds of technology companies and a large share of metro Atlanta's top tech employers, supported by fiber infrastructure the city began investing in decades ago. Tech Alpharetta, the city's innovation arm, has run a startup incubator downtown since 2015.

faq.q: What are the main areas of Alpharetta?
faq.a: The best-known areas are Downtown Alpharetta around Main Street, Avalon on Old Milton Parkway, the Windward area to the north, the North Point corridor along GA 400, and Crabapple on the west side near Milton.

faq.q: What ZIP codes cover Alpharetta?
faq.a: Alpharetta addresses mainly use 30004, 30005, 30009 and 30022. Note that 30022 extends into Johns Creek and 30004 extends into Milton, so an Alpharetta mailing address doesn't always mean Alpharetta city limits.

faq.q: How do people commute from Alpharetta?
faq.a: GA 400 is the spine of Alpharetta commuting, with exits 9 through 12 serving the city. Many residents work locally at the city's corporate campuses; others ride GA 400 south toward Sandy Springs, Buckhead and Midtown.

title: Christmas and Holiday Events in Alpharetta, GA (2026 Guide)
seoTitle: Christmas Events in Alpharetta, GA (2026): Tree Lightings, Avalon on Ice & Lights on the Loop
h1: Christmas and Holiday Events in Alpharetta, GA (2026)
description: Every 2026 holiday event in Alpharetta, GA: tree lighting dates, Avalon on Ice hours and prices, Lights on the Loop, where to see Santa, holiday markets, menorah lightings and Noon Year's Eve.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic evening scene of a charming small-town Southern downtown during the holidays, a tall lit Christmas tree on a town green, warm string lights in bare trees, families in winter coats strolling, an outdoor ice skating rink glowing in the background, warm charcoal and gold tones, no text, no logos, no readable signs, no recognizable real people

faq.q: When is the Alpharetta Christmas tree lighting in 2026?
faq.a: The City of Alpharetta's Season of Celebration tree lighting is Saturday, November 21, 2026 from 5 to 8 p.m. in Downtown Alpharetta. The Hamilton Alpharetta lights its tree on November 20, and the Lighting of Avalon is November 22 with the tree lit at 7 p.m. All three are free.

faq.q: How much is Avalon on Ice and when does it open?
faq.a: Avalon on Ice opens November 22, 2026 and runs through January 18, 2027. Tickets are $18 for general admission and $14 for kids 12 and under, skates included. Tickets go on sale November 3 at 10 a.m.

faq.q: Is Lights on the Loop free?
faq.a: Yes. Lights on the Loop is free and runs nightly from 5:30 to 11 p.m., December 4, 2026 through January 4, 2027, along the Alpha Loop between Northwinds Parkway and Old Milton Parkway. Free parking is at 2500 and 2520 Northwinds Parkway.

faq.q: Where can I take free photos with Santa in Alpharetta?
faq.a: The Alpharetta Convention and Visitors Bureau hosts free Pictures with Santa on December 5 from 10 a.m. to noon at 178 S. Main St., Suite 200. Avoid wearing green, since the photographer uses a green screen.

faq.q: Does Alpharetta have a Christmas parade?
faq.a: Yes. The Alpharetta Winter Parade is December 12, 2026 from 5:30 to 7 p.m. along Canton Street in downtown, and it's free.

title: North Point Mall Redevelopment and NHL Arena in Alpharetta, GA: What's Planned (2026)
seoTitle: North Point Mall NHL Arena Plan in Alpharetta, GA (2026): Vote, Fulton Funding & What's Next
h1: North Point Mall Redevelopment and the Proposed NHL Arena: Where Things Stand
description: What's planned at North Point Mall in Alpharetta, GA: the 20,000-seat NHL-ready arena, apartments, hotels and offices, the 4-3 council vote, Fulton County's $192.4 million TAD deal and why it all depends on an NHL team.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic twilight aerial-style view of a large suburban shopping mall site being reimagined as a sports and entertainment district, a modern glass-and-steel hockey arena glowing in the foreground, mid-rise apartment and hotel towers, tree-lined walking paths and a green park, highway traffic light trails in the distance, warm charcoal and gold tones, no text, no logos, no readable signs, no recognizable real people

faq.q: Is North Point Mall closing?
faq.a: Not yet. The mall is still open and managed by Jamestown. Developers have said major demolition or construction is likely a year or more away, and the redevelopment only moves forward if the NHL awards a team to the site.

faq.q: Did Alpharetta approve the North Point NHL arena?
faq.a: Yes. Alpharetta City Council voted 4-3 at its Aug. 24, 2026 meeting to rezone the nearly 100-acre North Point Mall site for a plan that includes a 20,000-seat NHL-ready arena, apartments, hotels, offices and retail.

faq.q: Does Atlanta have an NHL team coming?
faq.a: No team has been awarded. The NHL has 32 teams and has said it is exploring expansion interest, with a Texas group described as further along than Atlanta or Arizona. Alpharetta's North Point plan and The Gathering at South Forsyth are both pursuing a team.

faq.q: What happens if Alpharetta doesn't get an NHL team?
faq.a: The approved plan does not happen. The city set an Aug. 24, 2031 deadline for an NHL team award, and developers have said they would need a new plan and new city approval without one.

faq.q: How is the North Point project being funded?
faq.a: Through the North Point tax allocation district, which sets aside future growth in property taxes inside the district for improvements there rather than creating a new tax. Fulton County approved up to $192.4 million in future tax revenue on Oct. 21, 2026, contingent on an NHL franchise.

seoTitle: Thanksgiving in Alpharetta, GA (2026): Turkey Trots, Dinner & Events
h1: Thanksgiving in Alpharetta 2026: Your Holiday Week Guide
description: Plan Thanksgiving 2026 in Alpharetta, GA: the Gobble Wobble 5K at Halcyon, nearby turkey trots, Thanksgiving dinner downtown, Fulton County Schools break dates and holiday events all week.
coverPrompt: Photorealistic early morning scene of a festive Thanksgiving Day 5K fun run on a tree-lined suburban town-center street in late autumn, runners and families seen from behind and at a distance wearing warm layers, golden and amber fall leaves, soft low sunrise light with long shadows, a table with paper cups and small pumpkins near the finish area, warm charcoal and gold tones, no text, no logos, no readable signs, no recognizable real people

faq.q: When is Thanksgiving 2026?
faq.a: Thanksgiving is Thursday, November 26, 2026.

faq.q: Is there a turkey trot in Alpharetta on Thanksgiving?
faq.a: Yes. The 11th annual Thanksgiving Day Gobble Wobble 5K and Kids Fun Run starts at Halcyon, 6365 Halcyon Way, on Nov. 26, 2026. The 5K begins at 8 a.m. and the Kids Fun Run at 9:15 a.m. Registration is $50 for the 5K and $30 for the Kids Fun Run, and donations benefit Meals by Grace.

faq.q: When is Thanksgiving break for Fulton County Schools in 2026?
faq.a: Fulton County Schools is closed for Thanksgiving Break from Monday, Nov. 23 through Friday, Nov. 27, 2026.

faq.q: Which Alpharetta restaurants are open on Thanksgiving Day 2026?
faq.a: Up On The Roof in downtown Alpharetta is open 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. on Thanksgiving Day with a $49 three-course Thanksgiving menu. Other restaurants post holiday hours closer to the date, so call ahead before you go.

faq.q: What holiday events are happening around Thanksgiving in Alpharetta?
faq.a: The weekend before brings The Hamilton tree lighting (Nov. 20), the Season of Celebration tree lighting downtown (Nov. 21) and the Lighting of Avalon (Nov. 22), when Avalon on Ice opens. The Alpharetta Symphony's holiday concert is Saturday, Nov. 28.
